title: justicia pohliana
intro: Justicia pohliana, commonly known as Kalo or Kalo-pa, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Justicia pohliana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, that work together to provide its medicinal properties.
